title: Apam no sobufo a Wɔatu Wɔn Nnommum
intro: Wɔ mpɔtam foforo bi mfiase no, bere bi na abusuakuw bi te adan a wɔabɔ ho ban mu, na na apam bi akyekyere wɔn. Bere a woyii saa apam no mae no, nea efii mu bae no kae wɔ Kur’aan nkratafa so. Henanom ne saa nkurɔfo yi, na dɛn na ɛbaa wɔn afie ne wɔn nnuaba turo mu?
clues: Ná yɛte abannennen a ɛma yenya ahobammɔ ho adwene a ɛnyɛ nokware mu.
Na yɛyɛ nnipa a wɔka Kyerɛwnsɛm no ho, nanso yɛbuu yɛn apam so.
Yɛbɔɔ pɔw tiaa ɔbɔfo no bere a ɔbaa yɛn nkyɛn akyi, nanso yɛn nhyehyɛe no ankosi hwee.
Wɔnam Allah ahyɛdeɛ so twaa yɛn mmɛdua no, a ɛyɛ Ne tumi ho sɛnkyerɛnne.
Wɔpam yɛn fii yɛn afie mu, na yɛansan amma bio, sɛ asotwe wɔ yɛn asoɔden no ho.
Kur’aan no ka yɛn ho asɛm wɔ nhyiamu no ti no mu, na yɛn asɛm no yɛ kɔkɔbɔ ma wɔn a wɔbu apam so.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Wɔbɛka wɔn ahyɛ wɔn afie mu na wɔapam wɔn afi wɔn afie mu
Nsu a ɛremene wɔ po mu
Ɔsɛe a ahum bi de ba
trial.answer: Wɔbɛka wɔn ahyɛ wɔn afie mu na wɔapam wɔn afi wɔn afie mu

location.answer: Nnua a wɔde mmɛw ayɛ a wɔatwitwa

outcome.answer: Wɔatu wɔn akɔ nnommumfa mu na wɔafa wɔn agyapade

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
